sloka: दश सप्त च वर्षाणि तव जातस्य राघव ।असितानि प्रकान्क्षन्त्या मया दुह्ख परिक्षयम् ॥२-२०-४५॥
transliteration: daśa sapta ca varṣāṇi tava jātasya rāghava ।asitāni prakānkṣantyā mayā duhkha parikṣayam ॥2-20-45॥

translations.english: O Rama, I have spent the last seventeen years after your birth with the expectaion that my sorrows would come to an end.
